answer: Every DISCO in Pakistan, from LESCO and IESCO to K-Electric, bills homes on the same NEPRA domestic tariff, so each company's calculator here gives the same slab result for the same units; only the month's FPA line differs. Pick your company below, or use the checks for overbilling, sanctioned load and what an AC adds.

p: [[F2|LESCO]] (Lahore), [[F3|IESCO]] (Islamabad and Rawalpindi), [[F4|MEPCO]] (Multan and south Punjab), [[F5|GEPCO]] (Gujranwala), [[F6|FESCO]] (Faisalabad), [[F7|PESCO]] (Peshawar), [[F8|HESCO]] (Hyderabad), [[F9|SEPCO]] (Sukkur), [[F10|QESCO]] (Quetta), [[F11|TESCO]] (the merged tribal districts) and [[F12|K-Electric]] (Karachi) each have their own page with local notes. The [[F1|electricity bill calculator for Pakistan]] covers all of them in one place with the fullest explanation of the slabs.

sections.h2: Checks on a bill you already have
p: If a bill looks too high, the [[N1|overbilling check]] tests a long reading cycle and the slab it pushed you into, and the [[bill-index|Pakistan Bill Index]] shows the typical bill for your units this month. The FPA line is explained in the [[F14|FPA guide]] and time-of-use rates in the [[F13|peak hours guide]].
Before adding load, the [[N16|AC bill calculator]] shows what one more AC adds to the whole bill, and the [[N4|sanctioned load calculator]] whether the connection needs a load extension.

faq.q: Is the per unit rate different for LESCO, IESCO and K-Electric?
faq.a: No. All the ex-WAPDA DISCOs and K-Electric bill the uniform NEPRA domestic tariff for the year; the monthly fuel adjustment, FPA on most bills and FCA on K-Electric bills, is the line that can differ.

faq.q: What is the bill for {{pg.F1.out.units|int}} units?
faq.a: About {{pg.F1.out.total_rs|rs}} for an unprotected home on a {{pg.F1.out.sanctioned_kw|int}} kW connection before the month's FPA, of which {{pg.F1.out.energy_rs|rs}} is the energy charge at {{pg.F1.out.rate|rs2}} per unit. The [[F1|electricity bill calculator]] works out any other number of units.

faq.q: Why is my bill higher than the calculator?
faq.a: The estimate leaves out the month's FPA unless you enter it, and it cannot see arrears, a late payment surcharge or advance income tax on large bills. Copy the FPA from your bill, and if the reading dates cover more than a month, run the [[N1|overbilling check]].

A home whose last {{d.protected_months|int}} bills were all at or under {{d.protected_max_units|int}} units, on a connection below {{d.tou_threshold_kw|int}} kW. Protected homes pay much lower slab rates, and one month over the limit ends the status.
